title: 同道堂 Tongdao Tang
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: The central axis as it stood from the rebuilding of 1837 to 1860: the plan S01 gives the layout and the positions, the slip of 1855 the front hall's bays, depth, column and platform (A), the Tongzhi survey the courts (B), the leaf of 1744 the colours, the roofs and the galleries. 奉三无私殿's and 九洲清晏殿's own figures are on the Yangshi Lei sheets (E1161-E1171, not seen): their bays' widths, depths and heights are 圆明园殿's carried over (C).
rows: Layout

The axis as S01 draws it (re-read in Round 18 in plan pixels, B): front yard, 圆明园殿, first court, 奉三无私殿 and its terrace, second court, 九洲清晏殿; the plan's names here are of 1873 (Q36), the axis halls kept theirs
圆明园殿

Five bays 4.16 + 4 × 3.84 m, 7.04 m deep with porches of 1.92 m front and back, columns 3.84 m, platform 0.70 m with a 0.93 m edge (the slip of 1855, S310 rec. 11195, A); doors on the 金柱 line since 1837, open porches (B); rolled 硬山 after 1837 (record 11195's reading of the gables, B; the 1744 leaf drew a 歇山, Q100); Kangxi's plaque 圆明园 (S05, A); ear rooms at both ends (S01, C)
Front yard
Walled on two sides from the hall to the 前湖 (S01, B) with a stone landing (Round 9's YMC-023; its steps C); rocks at the water's edge either side (Malone's caption of the 1744 woodcut, places C)
First court

As S01 draws it, 22.6 m between the walls' inner faces; 34.5 m between the halls' eave columns, where the Tongzhi survey writes 33.92 m and a width of 25.98 m (样006-3, B; Q250); covered galleries with white walls and pierced windows along both sides (the 1744 leaf, B; where they run C); a gate in each side wall (C); two bronze vessels where S01 draws two marks (C); flowering trees (the leaf, places C)
奉三无私殿

Seven bays (S05, A) with porches front and back (record 7271, B), wall to wall as S01 draws it (23.3 m, B); the bays' widths, depth, column 4.16 m and platform 0.8 m (C); rolled 歇山, grey (the 1744 leaf, B); the front terrace as S01 draws it (0.6 m, C)
Second court
As S01 places the halls (21 m between the eave columns; the Tongzhi survey writes 18.27 m, Q250); galleries turning to 九洲清晏殿's porch ends (C)
九洲清晏殿

Five bays with porches front and back (record 7237, A; S05 says seven for the 1780s, Q101); widths to S01's 18.1 m, depth and heights C; rolled 歇山, the island's largest roof (the 1744 leaf, B); the three-bay rear porch 抱厦 of 1855 (records 7237, 10881, A; its form C); the plaques 九洲清晏 and 蔚然深秀 (S05, A)
West annex
The link and 同道堂 west of the hall, joined to it in the rebuilding of 1837 (E1169); at their boxes on S01, their form the class's (C)
Back and the lake
A paved way from the rear porch to a stone landing on the 后湖 (Round 9's YMC-031; the steps C)
Bridges
南大桥, 如意桥 and 棕亭桥 are models of their own (YM03-22, YM03-21, YM03-23), drawn by this model's generator
Assumed

Every elevation but 圆明园殿's (no picture of the rebuilt halls survives), the ear rooms, the gates, the link and 同道堂, the vessels, the brackets, the bridges' timber: the hall kit's classes and the Qing manual's typology (C, the pale tint with conf=1)

evidence.title: 同治十二年 上谕: 九洲清晏 halls renamed (as quoted in S220)
evidence.locator: S220 section 五; archive not seen
evidence.excerpt_zh: 绮春园改名万春园，敷春堂改名天地一家春，悦心园改名和春园，清夏斋改名清夏堂，圆明园九州清晏同道堂改名福寿仁恩，基福堂改名思顺堂，天地一家春改名承恩堂。清夏堂西宫门改名南宫门。
evidence.summary: The decree of 1873 gives the new names of Tongzhi's repair: 同道堂 becomes 福寿仁恩, 基福堂 becomes 思顺堂, the old 天地一家春 becomes 承恩堂. All three new names are written on the plan S01 at 九洲清晏, where its older names are not. So those labels cannot be earlier than this decree, and they are not names of the target state of 1860.

evidence.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析
evidence.summary: Dates three NLC Yangshi Lei water-course plans (about 1:2000) by the changes they show. It lists dated works: 1803 channel from 宁和镇 to 秀清村; 1810 镜远洲 at 平湖秋月; 1811 恒春堂; after 1828 清晖阁 replaced by 湛静斋; 1831 慎德堂; 1836 九州清晏殿 reduced to five bays with 同道堂 added west; 1846 洞天深处 four courts to two.

evidence.title: 法国巴黎《圆明园地盘全图》考辨: names and red lines at 九洲清晏 (王其亨, 张凤梧, 《中国园林》2009 no.12)
evidence.summary: The Guimet plan also carries the labels 思顺堂 and 承恩堂, with red lines of the Tongzhi project at 九洲清晏: a fourth depth for 慎德堂, a changed 同道堂 with its theatre, 九洲清晏殿 changed, and in the east road a square pavilion, galleries and a rear hall, with a pool. The authors date the red lines to 1873-74 and the base plan to 1858 or later. S01 at the same place shows a square pavilion in a round pool in the court south of its 七间殿.

evidence.title: 九洲清晏区域考古勘探报告
evidence.locator: mhymy 档案史料 12600, free part
evidence.summary: Survey report's opening: the island site measures 220 x 120 m (printed area 25,000 m2), with 8,600 m2 of buildings, 656 bays of halls and galleries in middle, east and west routes, not symmetrical. The earliest hall, 清晖阁 Qinghui Ge, is given as 1707, and building went on into Daoguang. The survey results themselves sit behind a paywall.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

reconstructions.title: 三幅样式雷圆明园河道全图辨析: west road of 九洲清晏 after 1828
reconstructions.why: Sequence of works on Yangshi Lei plans: after 1828 清晖阁 became 湛静斋 with 穿堂殿 and 后殿; 1831 怡情书史 and its fish pond gave way to 慎德堂; 1836 the three axis halls were rebuilt and 同道堂 added; 1846 the four courts of 洞天深处 became two. This fits the labels 前殿, ?顺堂, 后殿 on S01 as the former 湛静斋 group.
reconstructions.caveat: A reading of Qing plans, not a reconstruction.
